title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Settlement Figures for a Reconsidered Claim
content:
**Settlement of a reconsidered claim — Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan.**

(a) *The claim.* The claim reconsidered is the claim most recently filed on the plan; its loss date and peril are read from the claim as filed, and its property values are those of the latest adjuster assessment recorded on that claim.

(b) *Payable amount.* The settlement takes the general-property value plus each special-class value — jewelry, furs and watches; electronics; collectibles and art; firearms; business inventory — capped at the level's sublimit for that class, caps that sum at the level's coverage limit, and subtracts a deductible equal to the level's deductible, never going below zero, which gives the payable amount.

(c) *Room under the annual aggregate.* The room is the level's coverage limit multiplied by its aggregate multiple, less the claim payments, net of voids, issued under the plan in the 12 whole months before the handling date on claims other than the claim reconsidered, never below zero.

(d) *Amount approved.* The lower of the payable amount and the room, rounded to the cent only at this final step.

## Input — figure — output

| Input | Read from | Enters as |
| --- | --- | --- |
| property values by class | latest adjuster assessment of the claim | capped by class, summed, capped at the limit |
| deductible | the coverage level | subtracted from the settled sum |
| other claims' payments and voids in the last 12 whole months | the plan's claim handling histories | subtracted from limit times aggregate multiple |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Level figures assumed: coverage limit 3,600.00, aggregate multiple 1, deductible 150.00, electronics sublimit 1,400.00, other sublimits not reached. The latest assessment (made after a new receipt arrived) shows general property 1,050.00 and electronics 1,900.00. Counted: 1,050.00 plus 1,400.00, which is 2,450.00, under the limit; payable 2,300.00. Other claims on the plan show net payments of 1,550.00 in the last 12 whole months, so the room is 2,050.00 and the amount approved is 2,050.00.
